verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud exposes a documented OpenAPI 3.1 spec (21 paths) covering runs, sessions, events, structured output, stealth/proxy/CAPTCHA config, and auth profile reuse — the same capabilities described in the UI docs — and also ships a first-party MCP server verified to run keylessly via stdio. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report confirming full UI-parity via API (e.g. live-preview/2FA human-in-the-loop flows via API only), and community commentary focuses on security/MCP compatibility rather than confirming API completeness.
